annotations.title: Gemini Omni Unified Text, Audio & Video Multimodal Analyzer

description: Analyzes combined multimodal prompts spanning text, image descriptors, audio transcripts, and video temporal events using Gemini Omni Flash. Use when correlating information across multiple media modalities in a single reasoning pass; for running pure text-only reasoning or coding prompts, use generate_gemini_completion instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'input' ('modality_focus' defaults to 'cross_modal_synthesis'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (300 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

input.description: Multimodal prompt or media scene description to analyze.

modality_focus.description: Primary analytical lens applied to the multimodal input; defaults to 'cross_modal_synthesis' when omitted.

name: analyze_omni_multimodal_input

output.description: Unified multimodal analysis and extracted timeline.

title: Gemini Omni Unified Text, Audio & Video Multimodal Analyzer
